policy.text: Refund policy: refund the full order amount if and only if the issue is one of [damaged, not_delivered, wrong_item], the order is at most 30 days old, and the amount is at most $150. Otherwise do not refund. Use lookup(customer) to see the order.

args.body: Hi Vera, I've reviewed your order O2983. Since the item was damaged and within our refund policy, I've issued a full refund of $149. Your order status has been updated to resolved.

Hi Vera, I'm checking the status of order O3030. Since the issue is not damaged, not delivered, or the wrong item, and the order is 10 days old (within the 30-day window), I won't be issuing a refund at this time. Please let me know if you need further assistance.
Hi Vera, I'm sorry to hear about the damaged order. Since your order is under 30 days old, damaged, and under $150, I'll promptly issue a full refund for order O3030.
Hi Hana, I've received your damaged order O1315 update. I'm looking into it and will get back to you shortly.
We're sorry to hear about the damage to your order O1315. We'll immediately process a full refund of $98 for this damaged order. Your refund should appear in your account within 3 business days.
